note: For information on commodity code texts, please refer to the [Classification Database](https://metadata.scb.se/klassdb.aspx) on the Statistics Sweden website. Commodity codes and texts for the CN are also available in the [EU Classification Database](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/metadata/classifications) with both official and self-explanatory texts in different member state languages.

Values are shown in thousands of Swedish krona (SEK) in current prices if nothing else is stated. Weights are shown in metric tons, for some goods other quantities are shown such as cubic meters or pieces. Secrecy in the database is marked with … For foreign trade with services see Balance of Payments (BoP) in subject area Financial Markets (www.scb.se/FM0001-En).
